metadata.description: TARKAX Workflow Ontology mapping cross-industry business processes based on APQC principles.

workflows.name: Employee Onboarding
workflows.purpose: To integrate a new hire into the organization, providing necessary access, equipment, and knowledge to become productive.
governance_risks: Failure to collect mandatory compliance documentation
Inconsistent training leading to knowledge gaps
automation_opportunities: Self-service portal for new hire forms
diagnostic_opportunities: Tracking average days from offer to full system access
Identifying departments with the lowest onboarding CSAT

rationale.why_include: High frequency, heavily cross-functional, profound impact on employee retention and productivity. Every company does this.
rationale.data_needed: ATS state changes, HRIS entry logs, IT ticketing metrics (time to resolve onboarding tickets).
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Cross-departmental handoff efficiency (HR -> IT -> Hiring Manager).
rationale.recommendations_produced: Identify bottlenecks in IT provisioning, suggest parallelizing background checks with IT setup.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Employee Onboarding, this often manifests as: Delays in IT hardware provisioning

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between HR, Hiring Manager.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Failure to collect mandatory compliance documentation

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

automation_opportunity.description: Potential to replace manual effort. e.g., Automated ticket creation for IT/Facilities

scoring_template.7-8: High manual effort on structured data

compliance_risk.description: Regulatory or policy violation risk. e.g., Late I-9 verification

knowledge_dependency_risk.description: Reliance on specific individuals' tacit knowledge rather than documented SOPs.

scoring_template.9-10: Single point of failure (Key Person Risk)

throughput_risk.description: Inability to scale the process to handle increased volume.

workflows.name: Procure to Pay (Accounts Payable)
workflows.purpose: To manage the lifecycle of purchasing goods/services from suppliers, receiving them, and executing payment.
bottlenecks: Waiting for manager approval on POs
automation_opportunities: Automated approval routing based on amount thresholds
diagnostic_opportunities: Identifying vendors with high exception rates
Measuring cycle time from invoice receipt to payment

rationale.why_include: Core financial process. Directly impacts cash flow and operational efficiency. Very data-rich.
rationale.data_needed: ERP timestamps for PO creation, invoice receipt, match status, and payment execution.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Match exception rates, bottleneck identification in approval hierarchies.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Lower approval thresholds for specific categories, implement OCR for top 10 vendors by volume.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Procure to Pay (Accounts Payable), this often manifests as: Manual invoice data entry

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Procurement, Accounts Payable.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Maverick spend (purchasing outside approved channels)

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

automation_opportunity.description: Potential to replace manual effort. e.g., OCR for invoice scanning

scoring_template.7-8: High manual effort on structured data

compliance_risk.description: Regulatory or policy violation risk. e.g., Fraudulent payments

knowledge_dependency_risk.description: Reliance on specific individuals' tacit knowledge rather than documented SOPs.

scoring_template.9-10: Single point of failure (Key Person Risk)

throughput_risk.description: Inability to scale the process to handle increased volume.

workflows.name: Order to Cash (Accounts Receivable)
workflows.purpose: To process customer orders, deliver the product/service, and collect payment, ensuring revenue realization.
governance_risks: Failing to aggressively pursue overdue accounts
diagnostic_opportunities: Correlating sales reps with high invoice dispute rates
Identifying specific customer segments with high DSO

rationale.why_include: Critical for cash flow. Universally applicable. Immediate ROI if optimized.
rationale.data_needed: CRM won opportunities, ERP order fulfillment data, AR aging reports.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: DSO drivers, root causes of billing disputes.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Automate dunning notices for accounts 15 days past due, review credit policies for specific customer tiers.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Order to Cash (Accounts Receivable), this often manifests as: Manual order entry errors

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Sales, Accounts Receivable.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Extending credit without proper authorization

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

automation_opportunity.description: Potential to replace manual effort. e.g., Automated order intake via API

scoring_template.7-8: High manual effort on structured data

compliance_risk.description: Regulatory or policy violation risk. e.g., Revenue recognition errors

knowledge_dependency_risk.description: Reliance on specific individuals' tacit knowledge rather than documented SOPs.

scoring_template.9-10: Single point of failure (Key Person Risk)

throughput_risk.description: Inability to scale the process to handle increased volume.

workflows.name: Customer Onboarding
workflows.purpose: To guide a new customer from sale to first value, ensuring adoption and product familiarity.
bottlenecks: Customer delays in providing necessary data/access
Handoff friction between Sales and Customer Success
compliance_risks: Handling customer data inappropriately during setup
Failing to meet contracted SLA for deployment
automation_opportunities: Automated welcome emails and data collection forms
In-app guided tours replacing manual training
diagnostic_opportunities: Measuring the gap between sales close date and kickoff call
Identifying which implementation stages take the longest on average

rationale.why_include: Directly correlates with customer churn and lifetime value. High variance in execution across organizations.
rationale.data_needed: CRM deal close dates, project management milestone completions, customer login/activity data.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Standardize onboarding templates, enforce mandatory data collection pre-kickoff.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Customer Onboarding, this often manifests as: Customer delays in providing necessary data/access

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Customer Success Manager, Sales.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Scope creep beyond original contract

throughput_risk.description: Inability to scale the process to handle increased volume.

workflows.name: Incident Management
workflows.purpose: To restore normal service operation as quickly as possible and minimize adverse impact on business operations.
bottlenecks: Poor initial categorization leading to wrong assignment
Waiting on user response for more details
governance_risks: Failing to escalate high-severity incidents appropriately
Closing tickets without actual user confirmation
compliance_risks: Failing to identify security incidents hidden as IT issues
diagnostic_opportunities: Identifying recurring incidents that should be Problem Management targets
Analyzing MTTR by support tier to find skill gaps

rationale.why_include: High volume, data-heavy, critical for operational stability. Standardized process (ITIL).
rationale.data_needed: ITSM ticketing data (creation, state changes, resolution times, category tags).
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Escalation inefficiencies, root causes of SLA breaches.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Implement self-service for top 3 recurring ticket types, adjust tier 1 routing rules.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Incident Management, this often manifests as: Poor initial categorization leading to wrong assignment

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between IT Helpdesk, Engineering.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Failing to escalate high-severity incidents appropriately

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

knowledge_dependency_risk.description: Reliance on specific individuals' tacit knowledge rather than documented SOPs.

scoring_template.9-10: Single point of failure (Key Person Risk)

throughput_risk.description: Inability to scale the process to handle increased volume.

workflows.name: Month-end Close (Record to Report)
workflows.purpose: To finalize accounting data for a specific period to produce accurate financial statements.
bottlenecks: Waiting for straggling invoices or expense reports
Identifying and fixing journal entry errors
governance_risks: Lack of independent review for manual journal entries
diagnostic_opportunities: Tracking which specific accounts take the longest to reconcile
Measuring the volume of late entries delaying the close

rationale.why_include: High visibility to executives, highly structured, strict deadlines. Excellent target for process mining.
rationale.data_needed: ERP module close timestamps, journal entry logs, reconciliation completion dates.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Sub-process bottlenecks (e.g., AP close vs. AR close), manual entry volume.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Enforce strict cut-off dates for AP, automate specific bank reconciliations.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Month-end Close (Record to Report), this often manifests as: Waiting for straggling invoices or expense reports

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Accounting, Controller.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Lack of independent review for manual journal entries

workflows.name: Talent Acquisition / Recruitment
workflows.purpose: To identify, attract, evaluate, and hire suitable candidates for open organizational roles.
bottlenecks: Slow feedback from hiring managers after interviews
governance_risks: Inconsistent interview processes leading to bias
diagnostic_opportunities: Identifying stages where candidates drop out
Measuring manager feedback time to highlight bottlenecks

rationale.why_include: High strategic value, often decentralized and messy. Strong impact on organizational growth.
rationale.data_needed: ATS stage duration data, source of hire, offer acceptance status.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Hiring manager responsiveness, sourcing channel effectiveness.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Implement SLA for manager interview feedback, optimize sourcing spend based on conversion rates.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Talent Acquisition / Recruitment, this often manifests as: Slow feedback from hiring managers after interviews

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Recruiter, Hiring Manager.

workflows.name: Vendor Selection & Onboarding
workflows.purpose: To evaluate potential suppliers, select the best fit, and establish them in company systems for transacting.
governance_risks: Selecting vendors with conflicts of interest
compliance_risks: Onboarding vendors with poor data security practices
automation_opportunities: Automated risk scoring based on questionnaires
Self-service vendor portal for data entry
diagnostic_opportunities: Measuring time spent in Legal vs. Security review
Identifying departments that frequently bypass standard procurement

rationale.why_include: High risk, highly cross-functional (Procurement, Legal, IT, Business). Major source of organizational friction.
rationale.data_needed: Procurement system logs, contract management lifecycle timestamps, InfoSec review tracking.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Legal/Security bottleneck analysis, vendor compliance gaps.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Standardize contract templates to reduce legal redlining, pre-approve vendors for specific categories.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Vendor Selection & Onboarding, this often manifests as: Legal review of redlined contracts

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Procurement, Legal.

workflows.name: Sales Pipeline Management
workflows.purpose: To track and advance sales opportunities from initial lead to closed-won/lost status.
governance_risks: Promising unreleased features to win deals
diagnostic_opportunities: Analyzing win/loss correlation with time spent in specific stages
Identifying reps with high discount rates

rationale.why_include: Direct revenue impact. Highly measurable. Often suffers from poor data hygiene.
rationale.data_needed: CRM opportunity history, activity logs (calls/emails), quote generation timestamps.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Stage-to-stage conversion drop-offs, sales cycle bloat.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Implement stricter criteria for advancing deals to 'Proposal' stage, simplify pricing approvals.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Sales Pipeline Management, this often manifests as: Stalled deals in proposal/negotiation stage

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Account Executive, Sales Leadership.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Offering unauthorized discounts

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

workflows.name: Change Management
workflows.purpose: To control the lifecycle of all changes, enabling beneficial changes to be made with minimum disruption to IT services.
compliance_risks: Audit failures due to missing change documentation
kpis: Number of Incidents Caused by Changes
automation_opportunities: Integration between CI/CD tools and ITSM platform
diagnostic_opportunities: Correlating incidents with recent changes
Identifying teams with high emergency change volumes

rationale.why_include: Critical for IT stability and security. Balances agility with risk. High diagnostic value for DevOps maturity.
rationale.data_needed: ITSM change ticket data, CI/CD deployment logs, incident ticket linkage.
rationale.diagnostics_generated: Emergency change abuse, change failure rates by system.
rationale.recommendations_produced: Convert high-frequency, low-risk changes to 'Standard' (pre-approved) status, improve testing for specific modules.

bottleneck_risk.description: Risk of work accumulating or stalling. In Change Management, this often manifests as: Awaiting Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval

handoff_risk.description: Risk of errors or delays when transferring responsibility between Change Manager, Engineering.

governance_risk.description: Risk of control failure. e.g., Unauthorized changes to production environments

visibility_risk.description: Lack of real-time tracking across the workflow stages.

automation_opportunity.description: Potential to replace manual effort. e.g., Automated pre-approved standard changes

scoring_template.7-8: High manual effort on structured data

compliance_risk.description: Regulatory or policy violation risk. e.g., Audit failures due to missing change documentation

workflows.name: Budget Planning & Forecasting

workflows.name: Campaign Management

workflows.name: Lead Generation & Qualification

workflows.name: Brand Asset Management
workflows.purpose: To organize, store, and distribute brand assets and ensure consistency.

workflows.name: Quote to Cash / Contract Negotiation
workflows.purpose: To manage the process from issuing a sales quote to final contract signature.

workflows.name: Sales Forecasting

workflows.name: Partner/Channel Onboarding
workflows.purpose: To integrate third-party resellers or partners into the company's ecosystem.

workflows.name: Issue Resolution / Ticketing

workflows.name: Customer Renewal Management
workflows.purpose: To secure subscription renewals and minimize customer churn.

workflows.name: Performance Review Cycle
workflows.purpose: To evaluate employee performance, provide feedback, and determine compensation adjustments.

workflows.name: Payroll Processing

workflows.name: Employee Offboarding

workflows.name: Time & Attendance Management

workflows.name: Expense Management

workflows.name: Tax Reporting & Compliance

workflows.name: Purchase Requisition & Approval

workflows.name: Supplier Performance Management
workflows.purpose: To measure, analyze, and manage the performance of critical suppliers.

workflows.name: Problem Management
workflows.purpose: To manage the lifecycle of all problems (root causes of incidents) to prevent recurrence.

workflows.name: Access Provisioning / IAM
workflows.purpose: To grant or revoke access to IT systems, applications, and data.

workflows.name: Asset Management
workflows.purpose: To manage the lifecycle and inventory of IT hardware and software assets.

workflows.name: Software Release Management
workflows.purpose: To plan, schedule, and control the build, test, and deployment of software releases.

workflows.name: Enterprise Risk Assessment
workflows.purpose: To identify, evaluate, and prioritize organizational risks.

workflows.name: Internal Audit Execution
workflows.purpose: To provide independent assurance that an organization's risk management, governance, and internal control processes are operating effectively.

workflows.name: Data Privacy/GDPR Compliance Review
workflows.purpose: To ensure organizational data handling practices comply with privacy regulations.

workflows.name: Incident Response / Breach Management
workflows.purpose: To handle security breaches or cyberattacks effectively to limit damage and recovery time.

workflows.name: Product Roadmapping
workflows.purpose: To map out the vision and direction of the product offering over time.

workflows.name: Requirements Gathering
workflows.purpose: To define the detailed specifications for new product features or systems.

workflows.name: Sprint Planning & Execution
workflows.purpose: To plan and deliver a set amount of work within a specific timebox (sprint).

workflows.name: Quality Assurance / Testing
workflows.purpose: To ensure software or physical products meet specified quality standards before release.

workflows.name: Project Initiation & Scoping
workflows.purpose: To formally start a new project, defining its objectives, scope, and initial constraints.

workflows.name: Resource Allocation & Capacity Planning
workflows.purpose: To ensure the right resources are available at the right time for project execution.

workflows.name: Project Status Reporting
workflows.purpose: To communicate project progress, risks, and health to stakeholders.

workflows.name: Knowledge Base Article Creation

workflows.name: Document Control & Archiving

workflows.name: Inventory Management

workflows.name: Order Fulfillment
